name: v3_best_cg_sweep_s1
description: ATLAS V3 small best configuration (17.5/25/25 jetfoil lean, nose fans 30, ATLAS_09B masses 11.785 kg): CG swept by moving the 3.225 kg battery fore/aft (-0.20..+0.10 m) and down/up (-0.04..+0.04 m). Each point at its own trim pitch and hover thrust. Seed 1.
objective: phases.hover.pitch_err_rms_deg + phases.hover.roll_err_rms_deg + 0.05 * abs(phases.hover.yaw_drift_deg) + 0.5 * phases.hover.pos_drift + 0.2 * (phases.liftoff.pitch_max_deg + phases.liftoff.roll_max_deg) + 0.2 * (phases.landing.pitch_max_deg + phases.landing.roll_max_deg) + 2 * metrics.touchdown_speed + 5 * metrics.saturation_fraction
